scope: KGP indexer durable scan failures and worker error logs

behavior.cursor_failure: The durable cursor stores a fixed scan-failure label and exception class instead of raw RPC/database text.
behavior.worker_logs: Scan, rollback, lease-release, failure-persistence, and connection-close logs omit raw exception details and tracebacks.
behavior.recovery: Reconnect, rollback, failure recording, lease, and cleanup behavior remain unchanged.

coverage: cursor failure record is class-only after a synthetic database error
worker failure log contains only the exception class
reconnect and next-cycle scan behavior remain intact
connections close across failed and recovered cycles

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; mocked KGP connections and worker methods

limitations: No EVM RPC endpoint or database was accessed.
This does not establish live KGP indexing, chain reorganization recovery, or MAN-CAP-042 acceptance.
